decisions.reason: The component and DNP changes may later affect an order review, but they do not change the current obligation to select assembly settings and assess price and component availability.
The source selects a JST-GH connector and changes R6, but it does not revise the existing sourceability policy or report that either selected component is unavailable.
The power-board LED and resistor changes do not address KiCad project portability, library resolution, or the previously observed footprint warning.
R6 and the 270Ω CHGLED resistor are unrelated to the I2C pull-ups and series-resistor configuration.
Adding the charge-LED connector and changing R6 does not alter the AXP2101 VBUS-to-VMID path or the requirement that VMID and VSYS remain separate nets.
